dc:title: ERATV vehicle types matched to Wikidata classes (train-bodies)
dc:description: Automatic matching of the vehicle types in the European Register of Authorised Types of Vehicles (ERATV) to Wikidata rolling stock classes, by name. Not checked by hand. Made by tools/build_eratv_map.py from tools/build_classes.py in https://github.com/nakamura196/train-bodies

dc:source.dc:title: European Union Agency for Railways, ERATV (European Register of Authorised Types of Vehicles), list exported 2026-10-09

dc:rights: Type IDs and names: source European Union Agency for Railways (ERATV); reproduction is authorised provided the source is acknowledged (https://www.era.europa.eu/content/disclaimer-and-copyright-notice). Wikidata identifiers: CC0.

columns.name: eratv_type
columns.dc:description: ERATV vehicle type: the first four groups of the ERATV Type ID (its versions folded together)

columns.name: eratv_name
columns.dc:description: Name of the type in ERATV (of its first version)

columns.name: eratv_type_ids
columns.dc:description: The full ERATV Type IDs (versions) folded into this row, space-separated

columns.name: wikidata
columns.dc:description: Wikidata class this type was matched to

columns.name: match
columns.dc:description: name: the normalised name equals a Wikidata label or alias (an exact match candidate); prefix: the ERATV name cut back from the end matches, so the type is a version of the class (a skos:narrowMatch candidate)

columns.name: candidates
columns.dc:description: Number of Wikidata candidates for this type (more than 1: not decided, all are listed)
